gloss: within the prefecture; inside the prefecture

definitions.gloss: within the prefecture; inside the prefecture
definitions.explanation: The area inside the boundaries of a particular prefecture. Often used with の to modify another noun.

examples.japanese: {県内|けんない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{県内|けんない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: That university is the most famous in the prefecture.

examples.japanese: {県内|けんない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各地域|かくちいき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{代表選手|だいひょうせんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: Representative athletes gathered from every area within the prefecture for the tournament.

notes:
Refers to the area inside a prefecture's borders. Frequently used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, as in {県内|けんない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧ (schools in the prefecture).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {県内|けんない}⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧: various places throughout the prefecture
- {県内|けんない}⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: from within the prefecture
- {県内|けんない}⟦{屈指|くっし}→屈指：12367_kusshi⟧: among the best in the prefecture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {県外|けんがい}: outside the prefecture — the direct antonym
- ⟦{市内|しない}→市内：20934_shinai⟧: within the city — the equivalent at the municipal level
